articles.summary: Transaction expected to expand Porch Group’s Insurance Services business into Louisiana and add approximately $200 million in Reciprocal Written Premium and $25 million of Adjusted EBITDA (Excluding Reciprocal) in the first full year following closing Porch Group, Inc. (“Porch Group”, “Porch” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: PRCH), a new kind of homeowners insurance company, today announced that Porch Insurance Reciprocal Exchange (the “Reciprocal”) and Porch Group have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Allied Trust’s insurance carrier and managing general agency, respectively. Allied Trust is a regional insurance carrier operating in Louisiana, Texas, South Carolina and North Carolina. Louisiana represented almost half of Allied Trust’s 2025 premiums and would be a new state for the Reciprocal. The acquisition is expected to add approximately $200 million of Reciprocal Written Premium (“RWP”) i and approximately $25 million of Adjusted EBITDA (Excluding Reciprocal) to Porch.
articles.title: Porch Group Announces Agreement to Acquire Allied Trust
